# dsh-beta-layout-folder-file
**Claude-style folders, fork trees and drag-and-drop for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.**
English | 中文
Lots of workspaces and forked chats turn DSH's sidebar into one long list. This plugin lets you grou
p workspaces into folders, shows forks as a tree under the chat they came from, and makes dragging f
eel like Claude's sidebar. It doesn't replace anything: every row, button, menu and hover card is st
e's sidebar. It doesn't replace anything: every row, button, menu and hover card is still DSH's own.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features

**Organise**
- 📁 **Folders for workspaces.** Give a folder any name (*School*, *Robotics*, *Clients*
…) and put as many workspaces in it as you like. Folders collapse, rename, reorder and delete. Delet

ing a folder only ungroups it; nothing inside is lost.
- 🌳 **Fork tree.** A forked chat sits under t
he chat it came from, joined by a connector line. Click the ▾ to fold the forks away.

**Feel**
- ✋ **Claude-style dragging.** The item lifts into a floating pill, the list dims, rows sli
de apart around a dashed slot, and a folder lights up when you hover it. Drop on the slot and the it

em lands right there.
- 📜 **Scrolling titles.** Hover a title that's too long and it keeps scrolling
back and forth, so you can read all of it.

**Do more** (in each chat's **⋯** menu)
- 📦 **Export as ZIP.** Saves the chat with its sub-chats and

attached files to your computer.
- ✨ **Generate title.** The chat's own model reads the whole conve

rsation and gives it a short title. DSH by itself only names a chat once, from the first message.
-
⚙️ **Auto titles** (optional). Turn on *Generate an AI title after every reply* on the plugin's page
under **Plugins**, and titles stay up to date as the conversation moves on.

## Your first folder

1. Click the **folder-plus** button in the Workspaces header.
2. Type a name and press **Enter**.
3.
Drag a workspace onto the folder header. To take it out again, drag it back among the loose workspa
g a workspace onto the folder header. To take it out again, drag it back among the loose workspaces.
## FAQ

**Does it change my chats or files?**
No. It only changes how workspaces are grouped and ordered in
the sidebar, and chat titles when you ask it to (or turn on auto titles).

**Where is everything saved?**
Folders are saved in the app on this computer. Workspace order is sav
ed by DSH itself, so other DSH screens, like the workspace picker, use the same order. The auto-titl
e switch is saved in `~/.dsh/dsh-beta-layout-folder-file.json`.

**"Generate title" says there's nothing to summarise.**
The chat needs at least one message and repl
y first, so the plugin knows which model to ask.

**How do I remove it?**
Use **Uninstall** on the plugin's page under **Plugins**, or run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The sidebar goes straight back to normal.
## Good to know
- Folders and the fork tree appear in DSH's normal grouped view. The flat list and search results st

ay as DSH draws them.
- In **Workspace Tree** view, only top-level workspaces can go into folders.
-

Folders always sit above loose workspaces.
- A generated title is kept: DSH's own first-message tit
le won't overwrite it.
## For developers
The plugin has two halves and no build step; both are hand-written in DSH's plugin format.
- **Browser half (`lib/client.js`)** draws no UI of its own over DSH's list. It finds the Workspace

list (`[role="tree"]` next to the `sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` seat) and does four things:
- i

nserts folder headers, and tags member sections so CSS can indent or hide them;
- moves forked chats

under their source (`parentId`);
- keeps each folder's workspaces together through DSH's `workspace

s.insertBefore`;
- restyles DSH's native drag events with a pill image and the dashed slot.
It also adds two rows to `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` and a form to `plugins.bundle.config

`.
- **Host half (`index.js`)** registers `POST /api/dsh-beta-layout` on DSH's Connection for the se
tting and title generation, and listens for `turn/end` to run auto titles. Titles go through `@deeps
eek-ai/dsh-session-title-llm`, the helper DSH uses for its own titles, and are applied with `ctx.ses
-title-llm`, the helper DSH uses for its own titles, and are applied with `ctx.sessionTitle.rename`.
If a DSH update changes the sidebar's markup, folders and the tree simply stop showing, and DSH's li
hanges the sidebar's markup, folders and the tree simply stop showing, and DSH's list keeps working.
